text:
pagerduty: Alert fired for service=prod-gpu-hosts severity=high pd_id=PD9876542 - host gpu-prod-07 kernel panic detected.

pagerduty: automated note: incident created and paged on-call.

Alex K: ack. I'm taking initial lead. tagging @Maria G and @Jin P. Anyone from infra around?

Maria G: here, oncall infra. I'll grab console and logs.

Alex K: `kubectl get nodes | grep gpu-prod-07` -> NotReady, kubelet unreachable. A couple of embedding pods in CrashLoopBackOff.

Jin P: Grafana shows spike in 5xxs + p99 latency up. ops-bot posted the series.

ops-bot: Snapshot: embeddings-api errors +18% 5m, reranker errors +9%, node gpu-prod-07 reboot_count=1, kernel_panic=true.

Maria G: I have BMC console. grabbing `dmesg` from the prior boot sequence.

Alex K: paste dmesg when you have it. suspecting nvidia module oops.

Maria G: dmesg excerpt:
```
[  123.456789] ------------[ cut here ]------------
[  123.456792] kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[  123.456795] CPU: 1 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/1 Not tainted 5.18.0-rc1
[  123.456800] Call Trace:\n[  123.456803]  dump_stack+0x5c/0x8e
[  123.456806]  ? nvidia_uvm_unmap_gpu_vmas+0x15c/0x1a0
[  123.456809]  ? nvidia_uvm_find_gpu_by_device+0x40/0x40
```

Jin P: yep that's a GPU driver oops referencing uvm. probably a driver/kernel combo issue.

Samir P: recommend cordon+drain to avoid further scheduling on that host. Also escalate to infra for hardware check.

Alex K: doing `kubectl cordon gpu-prod-07` now. will start drain after confirming stuck pods.

Maria G: draining: `kubectl drain gpu-prod-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` - one stateful pod stuck on local volume. deleting and forcing reschedule under controlled tag.

eng-infra: We have physical console. we'll try a graceful power-cycle; collecting BMC logs and nv telemetry first. ETA ~10m.

Jin P: I'll shift traffic away from zone-2 embeddings pool and scale up warm replicas in zone-1. posting status to customers and statuspage with short impact notice.

ops-bot: embeddings-api availability dropped to 82% for 6m window. Marking incident as customer-impacting.

Alex K: PD notes: assigned to Alex K. Eng-infra oncall notified by phone. Leaving a runbook link in PD: /runbooks/gpu-host-failure.

eng-infra: performed remote power-cycle at 1768123600. host booted, but kernel landed in oops during nvidia module init. capturing kernel oops and nv logs to INF-589.

Samir P: we should block recent kernel driver rollout and revert driver package on affected hosts. I'll open a followup infra change.

Alex K: kubelet reported `failed to start: cgroup mount error` after boot, restarted kubelet and container runtime. now node shows Ready=false -> Ready=true observed. rescheduling in progress.

ops-bot: gpu-prod-07 status: NotReady -> Ready. Pod reschedules started. error-rate trending down.

Maria G: uncordoning node now: `kubectl uncordon gpu-prod-07`. Watching for flapping.

Jin P: traffic normalized, p95 back to baseline. no customer data loss observed. top-tier customers had failover to warm pool.

Alex K: PD: setting to monitoring for 1 hour to validate stability. leaving incident notes and linking INF-589. Handing watch to Maria for next 90m - need to hop on a call.

Maria G: taking watch. will escalate to P1 and page Samir if errors spike again.

eng-infra: INF-589 created with BMC logs and kernel oops. recommended actions: pin driver/kernel versions, add compatibility tests in rollout pipeline, and schedule replacement for suspect GPU if HW telemetry shows errors.

Samir P: action items: 1) postmortem draft, 2) add pre-flight driver compatibility test to host rollout, 3) add alert for repeated GPU oops to auto-cordon node. I'll own the rollout gating change.

Alex K: added dmesg excerpts and kubelet logs to INF-589. marking PD incident PD9876542 as resolved after 24m when metrics stable.

pagerduty: Incident PD9876542 resolved. Duration: 24m.

Maria G: closing watch, I'll ping when postmortem draft is up. thanks team. :thumbsup:
